title: Updating a list frame at one index
statement: For every integer list $l$, natural-number index $x$, and integer $z$, updating the function represented by the zero-padded list $l$ at index $x$ to have value $z$ gives the function represented by the list obtained by setting entry $x$ of $l$ to $z$, extending the list with zeros as needed.
